scope: Private checker lexical yield forwarding. All eighteen Go checker decisions have Rust execution witnesses. Recursively expanding forwarding environments, native/host block contracts and pending-address histories remain explicitly incomplete.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield 7}; end; def run; outer {|v| v}; end
def once; yield; end; def outer; x=1; result=once {x=2; yield x}; [x,result]; end; def run; x=0; result=outer {|v| x=v; x+1}; [x,result]; end
def once; yield; 99; end; def outer; once {yield}; 88; end; def run; outer {return 7}; 77; end
def once; yield; 99; end; def outer; once {return 7}; 88; end; def run; [outer {return 9},77]; end
def once; yield; end; def middle; once {yield}; 88; end; def outer; middle {yield}; 77; end; def run; outer {return 7}; 99; end
def once; yield; 99; end; def outer; result=once {yield; 88}; [result,77]; end; def run; outer {break 7}; end
def once; yield; 99; end; def outer; result=once {yield; 88}; [result,77]; end; def run; outer {next 7}; end

def once; yield; end; def outer; x=[]; result=once {begin; yield; ensure; x.push(9); end}; [x,result]; end; def run; x=[]; result=outer {begin; x.push(7); return x; ensure; next 3; end}; [x,result]; end
def twice; begin; yield; ensure; yield; end; end; def outer; twice {yield}; end; def run; x=[]; begin; outer {x.push(7); return 3}; ensure; return x; end; end
def once; yield; end; def outer; once {once {block_given?}}; end; def run; [outer,outer {7}]; end
def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield [7,[8,9]]}; end; def run; outer {|x,(y,z)| [x,y,z]}; end
def once; yield 3; end; def outer; x=0; result=once {|x| yield x; x}; [x,result]; end; def run; x=1; result=outer {|x| x=7; x}; [x,result]; end
def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield}; end; def run; x=0; outer {x="bad"}; x; end
cases.difference: Rust follows the captured integer binding through forwarded yield and diagnoses its reassignment to a string.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer -> int; once {return "bad"}; end; def run; begin; outer {return 7}; rescue; 9; end; end
cases.difference: Rust checks the return against the lexical owner contract after the inner block exits that owner.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield}; end; def run; m=/(a)/.match("a"); if m; begin; outer {m.captures.push(7)}; rescue; m.captures; end; end; end
cases.difference: Rust preserves match-data mutation protection through the forwarded capture.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield}; end; def run; begin; outer; rescue LocalJumpError; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust knows the lexical owner has no incoming block and diagnoses the catchable LocalJumpError.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield "bad"}; end; def run; begin; outer {|n:int| n}; rescue; 7; end; end
cases.difference: Rust checks the forwarded string argument against the block integer parameter.

cases.source: def once; yield; end; def outer; once {yield}; end; def run; outer {return 7}; missing; end
cases.difference: Rust preserves the nonlocal return destination and does not analyze the unreachable missing-variable tail.
